entries.title: Cybersecurity Foundations & Core Principles
entries.statement: Study foundational concepts and core cybersecurity principles of confidentiality, integrity, availability, and non-repudiation along with risk assessment, access control, and mitigation techniques.

entries.title: Threat Landscape & Adversary Knowledge
entries.statement: Evaluate the cyber threat landscape, including motivations of adversaries, known vulnerabilities, data exfiltration tools and techniques, and types of cyber attacks.

entries.title: Vulnerability Knowledge, Discovery & Assessment
entries.statement: Discover and assess the types of weaknesses and their severity in computing systems , including cybersecurity vulnerabilities, common application vulnerabilities, and system vulnerabilities.

entries.title: Emerging Risks & Threat Currency
entries.statement: Prioritize the landscape between current and emerging risks and threats.

entries.title: Offensive Security & Penetration Testing
entries.statement: Simulate offensive cybersecurity through penetration testing and vulnerability exploitation.

entries.title: Security Monitoring, Detection & Threat Analysis
entries.statement: Implement network monitoring, security assessment, and threat intelligence analysis, including intrusion detection and protection systems, unified threat management, and data collection and correlation using SIEM and SOAR technologies.

entries.title: Incident Response & Digital Forensics
entries.statement: Apply digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) knowledge and skills to cybersecurity breaches.

entries.title: Identity & Access Management
entries.statement: Implement identity and access managment (IAM) principles and practices, including least privilege access controls, identity-centric security, and continuous authentication and authorization.

entries.title: Network, Infrastructure & Architecture Security
entries.statement: Implement technical protocols and controls for architectural, infrastructure, and network-level defense, such as zero trust architectures, and operational security for industrial control systems.

entries.title: Cloud Security
entries.statement: Apply cloud computing protection mechanisms, such as configuration management, encryption, obfuscation, and tokenization, to secure cloud architecture and deployment environments.

entries.title: Data Protection & Data Security Controls
entries.statement: Implement data protection mechanisms, including data security controls, data classification standards, and data integrity practices.

entries.title: Secure Software Development & Application Security
entries.statement: Use DevSecOps practices to develop secure applications and software, including secure coding tools, bounds checking, input validation, error handling, and security testing.

entries.title: Protective Controls, System Hardening & Security Engineering
entries.statement: Apply security engineering principles and controls, including extended detection and response of endpoints to harden computing systems against cyber attacks across networks and applications.

entries.title: AI/ML Foundations & Core Principles
entries.statement: Study AI concepts, principles, techniques, and tools relevant to the AI system development lifecycle, including deep learning and generative and agentic AI systems.

entries.title: Emerging Trends & Continuous Learning
entries.statement: Research emerging AI trends, use cases, and practices to stay up to date in the computing fast-moving scientific and technology fields.

entries.title: AI algorithms and methods
entries.statement: Select and anlyze use case suitability of AI algorithms and methods from either classical AI  problem-solving paradigms (e.g., optimization search) or learnig paradigms (e.g., supervised fine-tuning), or both.

entries.title: Model Development & Training
entries.statement: Design, develop, and validate end-to-end AI models , including training pipeline, refinforcement learning loop, and supervised fine-tuning, and synthetic data generation.

entries.title: Model Selection & Optimization
entries.statement: Apply task requirements, selection criteria, and trade-offs evaluation to decide on the choice of model and its configuration, including data pipelines, hyperparameters, and hardware targets (e.g., GPUs, TPUs).

entries.title: Model Evaluation & Performance Metrics
entries.statement: Measure how well a AI model performs using metrics and appropriate evaluation methods of the model's predictive power, including accuracy, robustness, and generalizability.

entries.title: Data Management & Quality
entries.statement: Manage data quality required for AI systems, including best practices for data acquisition, collection, and curation.

entries.title: AI Infrastructure & Deployment
entries.statement: Design and operate deployment environments and production infrastructure for the AI system lifecycle, including sustainability considerations.

entries.title: Generative AI
entries.statement: Work effectively with generative AI and agentic AI by writing structured instructions and designing workflows with human-in-the-lead proactive supervision to allow agents to subdivide goals and self-correct and use external tools, databases, and orchestration.

entries.title: Agentic AI
entries.statement: Perform integrity checks on AI agent memories

entries.title: Human-AI Interaction & UX
entries.statement: Design and test human-AI interaction, including conversational prototyping, transparency and explainability, and agency and control balancing.

entries.title: AI Risk Management & Assessment
entries.statement: Manage AI risk mitigation through measuring metrics and methods, performing risk assessments on applications, and developing mitigation strategies.

entries.title: AI Test, Evaluation, Verification & Validation
entries.statement: Test, verify, and validate AI systems, including testing infrastructures and translating operational requirements into testing components across scenarios.

entries.title: Bias, Fairness, Explainability & Reliability
entries.statement: Detect AI errors, test for bias in datasets and outputs, and evaluate AI model explainability and impact of data quality on those models.

entries.title: AI Assurance, Documentation & Lessons Learned
entries.statement: Document assurance cases that meet stakeholders' needs, AI design and development activities, and failure modes of AI systems.

entries.title: AI Application, Use-Case & Business Alignment
entries.statement: Determine AI projects based on organizational needs and viable use cases, including business-process knowledge, priorities, and gaps.

entries.title: Secure AI Lifecycle
entries.statement: Apply secure AI lifecycle techniques, including risk assessment, security requirements, threat modeling, and testing to maintain confidentiality, integrity, and availability of AI systems.

entries.title: Secure AI Models
entries.statement: Implement access control and authentation mechansims for AI models and data, including meta data registries and user identify verification

entries.title: Privacy of AI Data
entries.statement: Protect data integrity and privacy of AI systems, including protective health information (PHI) and personal identifiable information (PII)

entries.title: Encryption of AI Data & Models
entries.statement: Apply cryptographic confidentiality and integrity control mechanisms for AI data and models.

entries.title: Defense of AI Training Data
entries.statement: Defend against data poisioning attacks of AI training data.

entries.title: Managing AI security Risks
entries.statement: Manage AI organizational security risks, threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation solutions, including disinformation and deepfake threats

entries.title: Defense of AI Reconnaissance
entries.statement: Defend against AI inference denial and reconaissance extraction to prevent resource exhaustion and assets exposure.

entries.title: Prevention of AI Malicous Code
entries.statement: Scan AI software and its dependencies, and prevent malicious code vulnerabilities by restricting library loading of untrusted code and verifying code signature

entries.title: Monitoring AI Systems
entries.statement: Implement telemetry logging and monitoring techniques for auditing AI systems and agents to track data access, tool use, and user identities.

entries.title: Secure AI Infrastructure
entries.statement: Secure AI deployment architectures and AI infrastructure

entries.title: Secure AI Operations
entries.statement: Secure AI operations, including best practices of threat intelligence, detection, investigation, and response

entries.title: Auditing Secure AI
entries.statement: Assess the security, integrity, and compliance of AI systems through continous review and auditing

entries.title: Secure AI Supply Chain
entries.statement: Verify AI provenance, trust, and integrity across the supply chain of AI compenents to reduce risks, including cryptographic checksums and the AI bill of materials (AIBOM)

entries.title: Permissioning AI Agent
entries.statement: Configure least-privilege permissions and lifecycle scoping for various AI agents, including single-user AI agents and shared AI-agent tools.

entries.title: Human Oversight & Secure AI Agents
entries.statement: Apply AI agent runtime security, including runtime safeguards, human-in-the-loop approval of agent actions, authentication for agent memory updates, isolating or sandboxing agent components, and agent tool inputs and outputs validation.

entries.title: AI-enabled Security Foundations
entries.statement: Study the foundations of AI applied to cybersecurity.

entries.title: AI-enabled Adversarial Robustness
entries.statement: Apply AI-integrity techniques to make models robust and resistant to adversarial attacks.

entries.title: AI-enabled Threat Modeling
entries.statement: Apply AI for threat modeling, risk management, and vulnerability assessment, including the design of mitigation techniques.

entries.title: AI-enabled Security Operations
entries.statement: Apply AI techniques and tools to augment and automate security processes and defensive operations.

entries.title: AI-enabled Defensive Tools
entries.statement: Assess and assure that AI tools are suitable for cybersecurity solutions based on their effectivenss, robustness, reliability, and trustworthiness.

entries.title: AI-enabled Offensive Attacks
entries.statement: Simulate and assess AI-enabled cyber offensive operations (offensive AI), including tatics, techniques, and procedures, such as penetration testing, vulnerability discover, and reconnaissance.

entries.title: AI Security Risks & Requirements
entries.statement: Assess project-level and organizational technical risks across the secure AI development lifecycle.

label: CyAI convergence
description: Competencies that bring both fields together

entries.title: Ethical dilemmas
entries.statement: Recognize and manage ethical dilemmas at every stage of the secure AI lifecycle.

entries.title: Laws and policies
entries.statement: Manage the impact of laws, regulatory compliance, and policies regarding AI-integrated cybersecurity technologies and secure AI technologies.

entries.title: Threat intelligence frameworks
entries.statement: Strengthen cybersecurity defense by leveraging AI-threat-intelligence frameworks, such as MITRE ATLAS.

entries.title: AISecOps
entries.statement: Integrate cybersecurity operations into all the stages of the AI lifecycle (AISecOps)
entries.support: Secure AI Operations (CY->AI) and AI-enabled Security Operations (AI->CY)

entries.title: Offensive operations
entries.statement: Identify attacker objectives by simulating and assessing AI offensive operations through cyber tatics, techniques, and procedures, including penetration testing, vulnerability discover, and reconnaissance.
entries.support:
AI->CY (AI-enabled Threat Modeling), 
CY->AI (Managing AI Security Risks, Secure AI Operations), 
CY Independent (Offensive Security and Pen Testing, Threat Landscape and Adversary Knowledge)

entries.title: Defensive operations
entries.statement: Protect and defend against adversarial attacks, such as manipulation of AI models through data poisioning and data leakage of PII/PHI.
entries.support:
CY->AI (Privacy of AI Data, Defense of AI training data, Defense of AI Reconaissance), 
AI->CY (AI-enabled adversarial robustness), 
CY independent (Data Protection and Data Security Controls, Threat Landscape and Adversary Knowledge)

entries.title: AI model hardening
entries.statement: Apply cybersecurity techniques to harden AI models against model distillation and adversarial inputs into training data.
entries.support:
AI->CY (AI-enabled Adversarial Robustness) and 
CY->AI (Defense of AI Training Data, Secure AI Models, Encryption of AI Data and Models), 
CY independent (Protetctive Controls, System Hardening, and Security Engineering)

entries.title: AI tools testing
entries.statement: Test AI tools against adversarial attacks in operationally realistic environments.
